items.risk: Epic 6/8A blocked on un-built Epic 2B notification infra; deferred dispatch + WS sync (8A.2/8A.3)
items.mitigation: Promote Epic 2B into the sprint or explicitly defer 6.2+/8A.2 until 2B lands (DEC-001 / PR #442)

items.risk: PR #435 merged with deferred security findings (#438/#439): P1-05 SSRF unfixed, P0-12 cookie scope, P1-04 Debug-format audit-hash domain — auth-layer issues that compound if deferred another sprint
items.mitigation: Assign pm-security sole owner of #438/#439; treat P0/P1 as pre-feature-work; SSRF fix tracked by plan security-ssrf-outbound-url-validation

items.risk: Two outbound-request sinks (signatures.rs:628 signed_url fetch, integrations.rs:2743 webhook-test POST) issue requests to unvalidated user/provider URLs — SSRF to 169.254.169.254 / internal services; a validate_external_url guard exists but is applied at only one of three sinks
items.mitigation: Extract validate_external_url to a shared module and apply at all three sinks before the request; consider re-resolving DNS at connect time (rebind defense)

items.risk: ProtectedRoute.tsx:117 role gate is fail-open: when user.role is falsy the role check is skipped and access is granted. Latent today (no route passes requiredRoles, AuthContext does not populate role) but will silently no-op the first role-gated route
items.mitigation: Deny on missing role; populate user.role in AuthContext; fix before role-gating goes live (fold into 79-2 / PR #444)

items.risk: Epic 81 frontend calls backend report-schedule endpoints (/schedules/{id}/pause|resume, /executions) that do not exist — 404 in production
items.mitigation: Implement the missing endpoints or feature-flag the frontend calls until they exist

items.risk: 10B handler stubs (10b-4/5/6/7) are mounted routes returning success with no business logic — callers get 200/204 for operations that never happened (silent data loss / incorrect UI state)
items.mitigation: Return 501 Not Implemented with a documented timeline until real handlers ship, so callers fail loudly

items.risk: OAuth provider (10A) backend complete but no agreed token/rotation/storage design and no admin-web client-management UI — divergent implementation + functional gap before any SSO consumer goes live
items.mitigation: Lock ADR for 10A consent/grant + token design before pickup; schedule admin-web OAuth client management

items.risk: Three ~4k-line route files (integrations/organizations/documents.rs) on hot multitenancy paths — review fatigue, RLS-predicate omission risk (a raw pool connection silently bypasses RLS)
items.mitigation: Module split; grep/clippy CI check that flags sqlx queries in these files not flowing through RlsConnection
items.mitigated_by: DEC-001 (2026-05-24): Epic 2B formally sequenced first; Epic 6.2-6.5 and 8A.2/8A.3 WS+dispatch slices formally deferred until 2B stories 1-5 land

items.risk: Duplicate AuthHandler/BuildingHandler modules: a security/correctness fix to the live route copy won't propagate to the dead handler copy, misleading reviewers
items.mitigation: Delete dead modules; enforce single implementation per auth/building op
